AKTA KERAJAAN TEMPATAN 1976

UNDANG-UNDANG KECIL PELESENAN PENJAJA
(WILAYAH PERSEKUTUAN LABUAN) 2016

PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh perenggan 73(1)(g)
Akta Kerajaan Tempatan 1976 [ Akta 171] (sebagaimana yang diperluas dan diubahsuai
oleh Peri ntah Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan (Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Akta
Kerajaan Tempatan 1976) 2010 [ P.U. (A) 439 /2010]), Perbadanan Labuan membuat,
dan m enurut seksyen 103 Akta,  Menteri mengesahkan , undang-undang kecil
yang berikut:

BAHAGIAN I
PERMULAAN

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Undang-undang kecil ini bolehlah dinamakan Undang-Undang Kecil
Pelesenan Penjaja (Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan) 2016.

(2) Undang-Undang Kecil ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2017.

Tafsiran
2. Dalam Undang-Undang Kecil ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna
yang lain—

"aktiviti penjajaan" ertinya menjual atau menawarkan untuk jualan apa -apa
barang di sesuatu tapak menjaja;

"barang" termasuklah apa -apa jenis makanan, perkhidmatan yang di beri atau
apa-apa jenis barang yang lain;

"fi lesen" ertinya kadar bayaran yang ditetapkan bagi sesuatu lesen yang
dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
Jadual Pertama;

"gerai" ertinya struktur yang didirikan untu k tujuan menjaja yang di atasnya
atau di dalamnya barang-barang dijual atau dipamerkan untuk jualan di tapak menjaja;

"kenderaan" ertinya suatu van, kereta tolak atau apa -apa kenderaan lain yang
diluluskan oleh Perbadanan untuk digunakan bagi tujuan menjaja;

"makanan" termasuklah tiap -tiap barang yang dikilangkan, dijual atau
digambarkan untuk digunakan sebagai makanan atau minuman bagi kegunaan manusia
atau yang diguna di dalam ko mposisi, penyediaan  dan pengawetan mana-mana
makanan atau minuman bagi kegu naan manusia dan termasuklah konfeksi, bahan
kunyahan dan apa -apa bahan lain untuk makanan, minuman, konfeksi atau bahan
kunyahan itu;

"pemegang lesen" ertinya mana -mana orang yang kepadanya lesen penjaja
dikeluarkan di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini;

"penjaja" ertinya seseorang penjaja bergerak, penjaja sementara atau penjaja
statik yang dilesenkan di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini;

"penjaja bergerak" ertinya mana-mana orang yang dengan atau tanpa kenderaan
pergi dari setempat ke setempat di mana -mana jal an untuk menjual atau
mempamerkan untuk jualan apa-apa barang;

"penjaja sementara" ertinya mana -mana orang yang menjual atau
mempamerkan untuk jualan apa -apa barang di gerai atau petak yang ditetapkan di
mana-mana jalan bagi maksud itu oleh Perbadanan untuk apa -apa tempoh dan
mengikut waktu perniagaan yang ditetapkan oleh Perbadanan;

"penjaja statik" ertinya mana -mana orang yang menjual atau mempamerkan
untuk jualan apa-apa barang di gerai atau petak di mana -mana jalan atau di mana-mana
petak peraga dinding;

"penyediaan makanan" atau "menyediakan makanan" termasuklah
mengendalikan, menghidang atau menjual makanan;

"Perbadanan" ertinya Perbadanan Labuan yang ditubuhkan di bawah seksyen 3
Akta Perbadanan Labuan 2001 [Akta 609];

"perkakas" termasuklah bekas, alat-alat, kerusi, meja, kelengkapan atau apa -apa
benda lain yang digunakan berkaitan dengan aktiviti penjajaan;

"petak" ertinya mana -mana ruang yang ditandakan oleh Perbadanan di tapak
menjaja bagi menjalankan aktiviti penjajaan;

"petak peraga dinding" ertinya suat u struktur yang diluluskan oleh  Perbadanan
yang dibina di atas atau bersebelahan mana -mana bahagian luar dinding sesebuah
bangunan;

"tapak menjaja" ertinya mana -mana bangunan, jalan atau kawasan  di mana
aktiviti penjajaan dibenarkan oleh Perbadanan pada hari atau waktu yang ditentukan
oleh Perbadanan.

BAHAGIAN II
PELESENAN

Lesen diperlukan bagi aktiviti penjajaan
3. (1) Mana-mana orang boleh menjalankan aktiviti sebagai seorang penjaja
apabila suatu lesen penjaja dikeluarkan oleh Perbadanan di bawah Undang -Undang
Kecil ini.

(2) Mana-mana orang yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan suatu
kesalahan.

Permohonan untuk lesen
4. (1) Tertakluk kepada undang -undang kecil 3, sesuatu permohonan untuk
suatu lesen di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini hendaklah dibuat dalam apa -apa bentuk
dan cara sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(2) Perbadanan boleh meluluskan atau tidak meluluskan sesuatu
permohonan untuk suatu lesen di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini.

(3) Perbadanan boleh, jika difikirk an perlu, menghendaki mana -mana
pemohon untuk hadir sendiri bagi memberi apa -apa dokumen atau maklumat lanjut
berkaitan dengan sesuatu permohonan untuk suatu lesen.

(4) Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini adalah
tertakluk kepada—

(a) tempoh lesen sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan;

(b) perjanjian penyewaan tapak menjaja ditandatangani oleh
pemohon, jika Perbadanan fikirkan perlu;

(c) peruntukan Undang -Undang Kecil ini, syarat -syarat dan
sekatan-sekatan yang dikenakan  oleh Perbadanan dan oleh
mana-mana pihak berkuasa yang berkenaan;

(d) bayaran deposit sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam
undang-undang kecil 8;

(e) bayaran fi lesen sebagaima na yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual
Pertama; dan

(f) apa-apa kehendak yang lain di bawah mana -mana undang-undang
yang berkaitan.

(5)      Perbadanan boleh, dari semasa ke semasa dan semasa sesuatu lesen masih
berkuat kuasa, mengenakan apa -apa syarat tambahan ke atas lesen itu atau mengubah
atau membatalkan apa-apa syarat yang dikenakan ke atas lesen itu.

(6)  Suatu notis bertulis hendaklah diberikan kepada pemegang lesen sebelum
Perbadanan membuat apa-apa keputusan di bawah perenggan (5).

Ketidaklayakan
5. Walau apa pun  undang-undang kecil 4, tiada lesen boleh dikeluarkan di bawah
Undang-Undang Kecil ini kepada mana-mana orang yang—

(a) bukan warganegara Malaysia; atau

(b) berumur di bawah lapan belas tahun.

Bentuk lesen
6. Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini he ndaklah
dalam apa-apa bentuk sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

Fi lesen
7. (1) Fi lesen  yang k ena dibayar bagi pengeluaran s uatu lesen di bawah
Undang-Undang Kecil ini adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama.

(2) Perbadanan boleh mengecualikan mana -mana pemegang lesen daripada
tanggungan untuk membayar kesemua atau mana-mana bahagian daripada fi lesen.

(3) Fi lesen yang dibayar di bawah perenggan (1) tidak boleh dibayar balik.

Deposit
8. (1) Perbadanan boleh menghendaki mana -mana orang yang kepadanya lesen
telah dikeluarkan untuk membayar deposit sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima
puluh ribu ringgit untuk memastikan bahawa peruntuk an Akta, Undang -Undang Kecil,
syarat atau sekatan lesen dipatuhi.

(2) Walau apa pun perenggan (1), Perbadanan boleh, jika difikirkan perlu,
mengecualikan mana -mana pemegang lesen daripada tanggungan untuk membayar
keseluruhan atau sebahagian deposit.

(3) Sekiranya terdapat pelanggaran mana -mana peruntuka n Akta,
Undang-Undang Kecil, syarat atau sekatan lesen, Perbadanan hendaklah memberi notis
kepada pemegang lesen dalam tempoh yang ditetapkan dalam notis untuk memberi
representasi kenapa depositnya tidak boleh dilucuthakkan.

(4) Perbadanan boleh, setelah mempertimbangkan repres entasi yang
dikemukakan oleh pemegang lesen atau jika pemegang lesen gagal membuat
representasi, memutuskan sama ada untuk melucuthakkan keseluruhan atau
sebahagian deposit.

(5) Tertakluk kepada perenggan (4), Perbadanan boleh menghendaki
pemegang lesen u ntuk menggantikan keseluruhan atau sebahagian deposit yang telah
dilucuthakkan.

(6) Deposit yang dibayar hendaklah, melainkan dilucuthakkan, dibayar balik
kepada pemegang lesen tanpa apa -apa pelarasan bagi faedah atas amaun yang
diberikan di bawah perengg an (1) selepas pemeg ang lesen berhenti menjalankan
aktiviti penjajaan di tapak menjajanya.

(7) Pemegang lesen hendaklah memaklumkan kepada Perbadanan jika dia
telah berhenti menjalankan aktiviti penjajaan di tapak menjajanya.

(8) Walau apa pun  perenggan (7), pemegang lesen hendaklah memohon
kepada Perbadanan dalam tempoh tiga puluh hari dari tarikh dia berhenti menjalankan
aktiviti penjajaan itu untuk depositnya dibayar balik.

(9) Sekiranya pemegang lesen tidak memohon untuk depositnya dibayar
balik ata u depositnya tidak dituntut dalam tempoh yang dinyatakan di bawah
perenggan (8), deposit tersebut akan dilucuthakkan dan hendaklah dibayar ke dalam

Kumpulan Wang Perbadanan Labuan dan hendaklah menjadi sebahagian daripada hasil
kumpulan wang itu.

Lesen gantian
9. Jika Perbadanan berpuas hati bahawa suatu lesen yang sah yang dikeluarkan
di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini telah hilang, cacat atau rosak, Perbadanan boleh
mengeluarkan lesen gantian.

Pindah milik lesen
10. (1) Tiada pemegang lesen boleh  memindah milik lesennya kepada
mana-mana pihak yang lain.

(2) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan
suatu kesalahan.

Pembaharuan lesen
11. (1) Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini tida k
boleh diperbaharui sebagai suatu hak dan sesuatu permohonan untuk memperbaharui
suatu lesen hendaklah dianggap sebagai permohonan untuk suatu lesen.

(2) Sesuatu permohonan untuk memperbaharui suatu lesen hendaklah
dibuat dalam tempoh enam puluh hari seb elum tarikh tamat lesen itu dan hendaklah
dibuat dalam apa-apa bentuk dan cara sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(3) Perbadanan boleh, jika difikirkan perlu, menghendaki mana -mana
pemohon untuk hadir sendiri bagi memberi apa -apa dokumen atau ma klumat lanjut
berkaitan dengan sesuatu permohonan untuk memperbaharui suatu lesen.

(4) Perbadanan boleh memperbaharui atau tidak memperbaharui lesen itu
dan hendaklah memaklumkan pemohon keputusannya itu secara bertulis atau melalui
apa-apa cara lain sebagaimana yang akan ditentukan oleh Perbadanan dan membayar
balik deposit kepada pemohon tertakluk kepada undang-undang kecil 8(9).

(5) Suatu lesen jika diperbaharui di bawah perenggan (4 ) adalah tertakluk
kepada—

(a) tempoh lesen sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan;

(b) bayaran fi lesen sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual
Pertama;

(c) peruntukan Undang -Undang Kecil ini, syarat dan sekatan yang
dikenakan oleh Perbadanan dan oleh mana -mana pihak berkuasa
yang berkenaan;

(d) pemegang lesen ti dak mempunyai tunggakan sewa di tapak
menjajanya; dan

 (e) perjanjian penyewaan masih berkuat kuasa.

(6) Tiada deposit lanjut perlu diberi oleh pemegang lesen jika lesennya
diperbaharui.

(7) Perbadanan tidak akan bertanggungjawab untuk membayar apa -apa
pampasan kepada pemegang lesen sekiranya lesen tidak d iperbaharui di bawah
perenggan (4).

Pembatalan lesen
12. (1) Perbadanan boleh membatalkan suatu lesen yan g dikeluarkan di bawah
undang-undang kecil 4 jika ia berpuas hati bahawa—

(a) pemegang lesen it u telah melanggar mana -mana peruntukan Akta,
Undang-Undang Kecil, syarat atau sekatan lesen;

(b) pemegang lesen itu telah, sama ada berkaitan dengan sesuatu
permohonan untuk suatu lesen itu atau pada bila -bila masa

selepas suatu lesen dikeluarkan, mengemukakan kepada
Perbadanan suatu dokumen atau perisytiharan yang palsu,
mengelirukan atau tidak tepat; atau

(c) pemegang lesen itu tidak menjalankan aktiviti penjajaan yang
dilesenkan selama tempoh tiga bulan berturut -turut tanpa
memaklumkan kepada Perbadanan.

(2) Pembatalan lesen di bawah perenggan (1) boleh dibuat oleh Perbadanan
tanpa apa -apa bayaran pampasan kepada pemegang lesen  dan Perbadanan boleh
melucuthakkan keseluruhan deposit yang telah dibayar di bawah undang -undang
kecil 8.

(3) Sebelum suatu lesen dibatalkan , Perbadanan hendaklah memberi notis
secara bertulis kepada pemegang lesen menghendaki dia membuat representasi dalam
tempoh sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam notis kenapa lesennya tidak boleh
dibatalkan.

(4) Selepas tamat tem poh masa yang dinyatakan di dalam notis di bawah
perenggan (3) dan setelah menimbangkan representasi pemegang lesen atau jika
pemegang lesen gagal membuat representasi, Perbadanan hendaklah terus
mempertimbangkan perkara tersebut dan memaklumkan keputusannya dalam notis
bertulis kepada pemegang lesen.

 (5) Jika Perbadanan memutuskan untuk membatalkan lesen itu, pembatalan
lesen itu hendaklah mula berkuat  kuasa pada tarikh yang dinyatakan dalam notis yang
diserahkan kepada pemegang lesen.

(6) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang  menjalankan aktiviti penjajaan setelah
lesennya dibatalkan di bawah perenggan (5) melakukan suatu kesalahan.

BAHAGIAN III
PERUNTUKAN AM

Kandungan lesen
13. Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan oleh Perbadanan kepada seseorang pemegang
lesen di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini hendaklah mengandungi butir -butir yang
berikut:

(a) nama, alamat terbaharu dan nombor kad pengenalan pemegang lesen;

(b) gambar terbaharu berukuran pasport pemegang lesen;

(c) jenis penjaja;

(d) tempoh sah lesen;

(e) jenis barang yang akan dijual;

(f) nama, alamat terba haru, nombor kad pengenalan  dan gambar terba haru
berukuran pasport pembantu yang diambil kerja oleh pemegang lesen,
jika ada;

(g) tempoh dan waktu menjaja;

(h) tapak menjaja; dan

(i) apa-apa syarat dan sekatan yang lain yang dikenakan oleh Perbadanan.

Larangan
14. (1) Tiada pemegang lesen boleh—

(a) mengambil bekerja mana -mana orang di bawah umur lapan belas
tahun;

(b) mengambil bekerja mana-mana warga asing;

(c) membenarkan apa -apa a ktiviti perjudian atau aktiviti  tidak
bermoral atau membena rkan apa -apa perbuatan yang boleh
menyebabkan kacau ganggu, gangguan, kecederaan atau
kebisingan kepada penduduk di kawasan persekitaran tapak
menjaja; dan

(d) menjalankan aktiviti yang lain di tapak menjaja selain daripada
aktiviti penjajaan yang dinyatakan dalam lesennya.

(2) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan
suatu kesalahan.

Pemeriksaan perubatan dan kursus asas penyediaan makanan
15. (1) Mana-mana orang yang terlibat dalam penyediaan makanan untuk aktiviti
penjajaan hendaklah—

(a) menjalani pemeriksaan perubatan sebagaimana yang Perbadanan
arahkan;

(b) mendapatkan suntikan pelalian terhadap penyakit berjangkit; dan

(c) menghadiri kursus asas penyediaan makanan yang diiktiraf oleh
Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia.

(2) Pemeriksaan perubatan dan suntikan pelalian terhadap penyakit
berjangkit hendaklah dijalankan oleh pegawai perubatan atau kesihatan yang berdaftar
di bawah Akta Perubatan 1971 [Akta 50].

(3) Pemegang lesen hendaklah—

(a) mematuhi keperluan perenggan (1) sekiranya pemegang lesen itu
sendiri akan terlibat dalam penyediaan makanan  untuk aktiviti
penjajaan; dan

(b) memastikan penamanya yang dilantik  di bawah undang -undang
kecil 17  dan pembantu nya yang diambil bekerja  di bawah
undang-undang kecil 18  yang terlibat dalam penyediaan makanan
mematuhi keperluan perenggan (1).

(4) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang tidak mematuhi perenggan (3 )
melakukan suatu kesalahan.

(5) Walau apa pun perenggan (1), mana -mana orang yang terlibat dalam
penyediaan makanan  untuk ak tiviti penjajaan boleh diarahkan oleh Perbadanan pada
bila-bila masa untuk—

(a) menjalani pemeriksaan perubatan;

(b) mendapatkan suntikan pelalian terhadap penyakit berjangkit; dan

(c) menghadiri kursus asas berkaitan dengan penyediaan makanan.

(6) Mana-mana orang yang tidak mematuhi perenggan (5) melakukan suatu
kesalahan.

Kewajipan pemegang lesen
16. (1) Seseorang p emegang lesen hendaklah pada setiap masa hadir untuk
menjalankan atau mengawasi aktiviti penjajaannya.

(2) Walau apa pun perenggan (1) , jika pemegang lesen tidak dapat hadir
untuk menjalankan aktiviti penjajaannya selama tempoh tiga puluh hari atau lebih, dia
hendaklah—

(a) melantik seorang penama di bawah undan g-undang kecil 17  bagi
menggantikannya; atau

(b) menutup sementara petak yang diperuntukkan kepadanya.

(3) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang melanggar perenggan (1) dan (2)
melakukan suatu kesalahan.

Pelantikan penama
17. (1) Sesuatu permohonan untuk seorang penama di bawah undang-undang
kecil 16(2)(a) hendaklah dibuat dalam apa -apa bentuk dan cara  yang ditentukan oleh
Perbadanan.

(2) Perbadanan boleh—

(a) menghendaki pemegang lesen untuk mengemukakan maklumat
lanjut bagi maksud mempertimbangkan permohonan tersebut;
atau

(b) meluluskan permohonan itu tertakluk kepada syarat yang lain atau
menolak permohonan itu.

(3) Fi yang kena dibayar oleh pemegang lesen bagi permohonan pelantikan
seorang penama hendaklah sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual Kedua.

(4) Seseorang penama yang dilantik di bawah perenggan (2) hendaklah
tertakluk kepada Undang -Undang Kecil ini, syarat dan sekatan yang dikenakan oleh
Perbadanan ke atas pemegang lesen dan mempunyai tanggungan yang sama
sebagaimana seorang pemegang lesen.

Pengambilan pembantu
18. (1) Seseorang p emegang lesen tidak boleh mengambil bekerja mana-mana
orang sebagai pembantu tanpa kelulusan bertulis daripada Perbadanan terlebih dahulu.

(2) Sesuatu permohonan bagi suatu kelulusan di bawah perenggan (1)
hendaklah dibuat dalam apa -apa bentuk dan cara sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh
Perbadanan.

(3) Perbadanan boleh—

(a) menghendaki pemegang lesen untuk mengemukakan maklumat
lanjut bagi maksud mempertimbangkan permohonan tersebut;
atau

(b) meluluskan permohonan itu tertakluk kepada syarat yang lain atau
menolak permohonan itu.

(4) Pengambilan kerja seseorang pembantu tidak mengecualikan pemegang
lesen daripada undang-undang kecil 16(1).

(5) Mana-mana p embantu yang diambil bekerja di bawah perenggan (4)
adalah tertakluk kepada—

(a) peruntukan Undang -Undang Kecil, syarat dan sekatan yang
dikenakan oleh Perbadanan di bawah  undang-undang kecil 4(4);
dan

(b) apa-apa syarat yang lain yang ditetapkan oleh Perbadanan
di bawah subperenggan 3(b).

(6) Walau apa pun  undang-undang kecil ini, m ana-mana pemegang lesen
yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan suatu kesalahan.

Lesen hendaklah berkenaan dengan tapak menjaja tertentu
19. (1) Lesen yang  dikeluarkan di bawah  undang-undang kecil 4 hendaklah
berkenaan dengan sesuatu tapak menjaja tertentu sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
lesen itu.

LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT 1976

LICENSING OF HAWKERS
(FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN) BY-LAWS 2016

IN exercise of the power  conferred by paragraph 73(1)(g) of the
Local Government Act 1976 [ Act 171 ] (as extende d and modified by the Federal
Territory of Labuan (Extension and Modification of Local Government Act 1976)
Order 2010 [ P.U. (A) 439/2010 ]), the  Perbadanan Labuan makes, and pur suant to
section 103 of the Act, the Minister confirms, the following by-laws:

PART I
PRELIMINARY

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These by-laws may be cited as the Licensing of Hawkers
(Federal Territory of Labuan) By-Laws 2016.

(2) These By-laws comes into operation on 1 January 2017.

Interpretation
2. In these By-laws, unless the context otherwise requires—

"hawking activity " means the selling or offering  for sale  any goods at a
hawking site;

"goods" includes any type of food, services rendered or any other type of goods;

"licence fee" means the prescribed payment rate for a licence issued under these
By-laws as specified in the First Schedule;

"stall" means a structure erected for the purpose of hawking on which or in
which goods are sold or displayed for sale at a hawking site;

"vehicle" means a van, cart or any other vehicle approved by the Perbadanan to
be used for the purpose of hawking;

"food" includes every goods manufactured, sold or represented for use as food or
drink for human consumption or which is used in the compo sition, preparation and
preservation of any food or drink for human consumption and includes confectionery,
chewing materials and any other ingredient of such  food, beverage, confectionery or
chewing substances;

"licensee" means any person to whom a hawke r licence is issued under these
By-laws;

"hawker" means an itinerant hawker, temporary hawker or static hawker
licensed under these By-laws;

"itinerant hawker" means any person who with or without a vehicle goes from
place to place on any road to sell or display for sale any goods;

"temporary hawker" means any person who sells or displays for sale any goods
at a stall or pitch identified on any road for that purpose by the Perbadanan for such
period and according to the business hour as may be determined by the Perbadanan;

"static hawker" means any person who sells or displays for sale any goods at a
stall or pitch on any road or at any wall showcase;

"food preparation" or "preparing food" includes handling, serving or selling food;

"Perbadanan" means the Perbadanan Labuan as a statutory body established
under section 3 of the Perbadanan Labuan Act 2001 [Act 609];

"equipment" includes containers, utensils, chairs, tables, equipment or any other
thing used in connection with hawking activity;

"pitch" means any space marked out by the Perbadanan at a hawking site to
operate the hawking activity;

"wall showcase" means a structure approved by the Perbadanan which is erected
on or against any part of any wall of a building;

"hawking site " means any building, road or area where hawking activity  is
permitted by the Perbadanan on the day or time specified by the Perbadanan.

PART II
LICENSING

Licence required for hawking activity
3. (1) Any person may carry out activities as a hawker when a hawker licence is
issued by the Perbadanan under these By-laws.

(2) Any person who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Application for licence
4. (1) Subject to by-law 3, an application for a licence under these By -laws shall
be made in such form and manner as determined by the Perbadanan.

(2) The Perbadanan may approve or not approve an application for a licence
under these By-laws.

(3) The Perbadanan may, if it thinks necessary, require any applicant to
attend in person to furnish any  document or further information regarding an
application for a licence.

(4) A licence issued under these By-laws shall be subject to—

(a) the licence period as determined by the Perbadanan;

(b) the tenancy agreement of the hawking site signed by the applican t,
if the Perbadanan thinks necessary;

(c) the provisions of these By -laws, conditions and restrictions
imposed by the Perbadanan and by any relevant authorities;

(d) payment of deposit as provided in by-law 8;

(e) payment of a licence fee as prescribed in the First Schedule; and

(f) any other requirements under any relevant laws.

(5) The Perbadanan may, from time to time and while a licence is still in
force, impose any additional conditions on the licence or amend or revoke any condition
imposed on the licence.

(6)  A written notice shall be given to the licensee before the Perbadanan
makes any decision under paragraph (5).

Disqualification
5. Notwithstanding by-law 4, no licence shall be issued under these By-laws to any
person who is—

(a) a non-citizen of Malaysia; or

(b) under the age of eighteen years old.

Form of licence
6. A licence issued under these By -laws shall be in any form as may be determined
by the Perbadanan.

Licence fee
7. (1) The licence fee payable for the issuance of a licen ce under these By -laws
is as prescribed in the First Schedule.

(2) The Perbadanan may exempt any licensee from the liability of paying the
whole or any part of the licence fee.

(3) The licence fee paid under paragraph (1) shall not be refundable.

Deposit
8. (1) The Perbadanan may require any person to whom a licence is issued to
pay a deposit of an amount of money not exceeding fifty thousand ringgit to ensure that
the provisions of the Act, By-laws, conditions or restrictions of the licence are observed.

(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Perbadanan may, if it thinks
necessary, exempt any licensee from the liability of paying the whole or any part of the
deposit.

(3) If there is a breach of any provision s of the Act, By -laws, conditions or
restrictions of the licence, the Perbadanan shall give a notice to the licensee within the
time specified in the notice to give representation as to why his deposit shall not be
forfeited.

(4) The Perbadanan may, after considering the representation given by the
licensee or if the licensee fails to make a representation, decides either to forfeit the
whole or part of the deposit.

(5) Subject to paragraph (4), the Perbadanan may require the licensee to
replenish the whole or part of the deposit that has been forfeited.

(6) The deposit paid shall, unless forfeited, be refunded to the licensee
without any adjustment for interest on the amount deposited under paragraph (1) after
the licensee has ceased operating the hawking activity at his hawking site.

(7) The licen see shall inform the Perbadanan if he has ceased operating the
hawking activity at his hawking site.

(8) Notwithstanding paragraph (7), the licensee shall apply to the
Perbadanan within thirty days from the date he has ceased operating the hawking
activity for his deposit to be refunded.

(9) If the licensee does not apply for his deposit to be refunded or the deposit
is not claimed within the period specified in paragraph (8), the deposit shall be forfeited
and shall be paid into the Perbadanan Labuan Fun d and shall form part of the revenue
of the fund.

Replacement licence
9. If the Perbadanan is satisfied that any valid licence issued under these By -laws is
lost, defaced or damaged, the Perbadanan may issue a replacement licence.

Transfer of licence
10. (1) No licensee shall transfer his licence to any other party.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Renewal of licence
11. (1) A licence issued under these By -laws shall not be renewed as a right and
an application for renewal of a licence shall be deemed as an application for a licence.

(2) An application for renewal of a licence shall be made within sixty days
before the expiry of the licence and shall be made in such form and manner as may be
determined by the Perbadanan.

(3) The Perbadanan may, if it thinks necessary, require any applicant to
attend in person to furnish any  document or further information regarding an
application to renew a licence.

(4) The Perbadanan may renew or not renew a licence and shall inform t he
applicant of its decision in writing or by any other manner as may be determined by the
Perbadanan and to refund the deposit to the applicant subject to by-law 8(9).

(5) A licence if renewed under paragraph (4) shall be subject to—

(a) the licence period as determined by the Perbadanan;

(b) payment of a licence fee as prescribed in the First Schedule;

(c) the provisions of these By -laws, conditions and restrictions
imposed by the Perbadanan and by any relevant authorities;

(d) the licensee does not have any rental arrears for his hawking site;
and

(e) the tenancy agreement is still in force.

(6) No further deposit need to be given by the licensee if his licence is
renewed.

(7) The Perbadanan shall not be responsible to pay any compensation to the
licensee if the licence is not renewed under paragraph (4).

Revocation of licence
12. (1) The Perbadanan may r evoke a licence issued under  by-law 4 if it  is
satisfied that—

(a) the licensee has contravened any provision s of these Act, By -laws,
conditions or restrictions of the licence;

(b) the licensee has, either in relati on to the application of a licence or
at any time after the licence is issued, submitted to the Perbadanan

a document or declaration which is false, confusing or not
accurate; or

(c) the licensee has not  operated the licensed hawking activity  for a
consecutive period of three months without informing the
Perbadanan.

(2) The r evocation of a licence under  paragraph (1) may be made by the
Perbadanan without any payment of compensation to the licensee  and the Perbadanan
may forfeit the whole deposit paid under by-law 8.

(3) Before a licence  is revoked, the Perbadanan shall give a notice in writing
to the licensee requiring him to make a representation within the period as specified in
the notice as to why his licence shall not be revoked.

(4) After the expiry of the period s pecified in the notice under paragraph (3)
and after considering the licensee's representation or if the licensee fails to make a
representation, the Perbadanan shall proceed to consider such matter and inform its
decision in a written notice to the licensee.

  (5) If the Perbadanan decides to revoke the licence, the revocation of the
licence shall take effect on the date specified in the notice served to the licensee.

 (6) Any licensee who  operates a hawking activity after his license is revoked
under paragraph (5) commits an offence.

PART III
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Contents of licence
13. A licence issued by the Perbadanan to a licensee under these By -laws shall
contain the following particulars:

(a) the name, recent address and identity card number of the licensee;

(b) a recent passport size photograph of the licensee;

(c) the type of hawker;

(d) the validity period of licence;

(e) the type of goods to be sold;

(f) the name, recent address, identity card number  and recent passport size
photograph of the assistant employed by the licensee, if any;

(g) period and time of hawking;

(h) hawking site; and

(i) any other conditions and restrictions imposed by the Perbadanan.

Prohibitions
14. (1) No licensee shall—

(a) employ any person who is under the age of eighteen years old;

(b) employ any foreign person;

(c) allow any gambling or immoral activities or permit any conduct
which will cause a nuisance, disturbance, injury or noisiness to the
residents within the surrounding area of hawking site; and

(d) operate other activities at the hawking site other than the hawking
activity specified in his licence.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Medical examination and basic course in food preparation
15. (1) Any person who is involved in food preparation for hawking activity
shall—

(a) undergo a medical examination as the Perbadanan may direct;

(b) be inoculated against any infectious diseases; and

(c) attend a basic course for food prepa ration recognised by the
Ministry of Health Malaysia.

(2) The medical examination and inoculation against any infectious disease s
shall be carried out by a medical or health officer registered under the Medical Act 1971
[Act 50].

(3) The licensee shall—

(a) comply with the requirement s of paragraph (1) if the licensee
himself is involved in food preparation for hawking activity; and

(b) ensure that  his nominee appointed under  by-law 17  and his
assistant employed under  by-law 18 involved in food preparat ion
comply with the requirements under paragraph (1).

(4) Any licensee who fails to comply with paragraph (3) commits an offence.

(5) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), any person who is involved in food
preparation for hawking activity may be directed by the Perbadanan at any time to—

(a) undergo a medical examination;
(b) be inoculated against any infectious diseases; and

(c) attend a basic course relating to food preparation.

(6) Any person who fails to comply with paragraph (5) commits an offence.

Obligations of the licensee
16. (1) A licensee shall at all times be present to conduct or monitor his hawking
activity.

(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), if the licensee cannot be present to
conduct his hawking activity for a period of thirty days or more, he shall—

(a) appoint a nominee under by-law 17 to replace him; or

(b) temporarily close the pitch allocated to him.

(3) Any licensee who contravenes paragraphs (1) and (2) commits an offence.

Appointment of nominee
17. (1) An application for a nominee under by-law 16(2)(a) shall be made in such
form and manner as determined by the Perbadanan.

(2) The Perbadanan may—

(a) require the licensee to submit  further information for the purpose
of considering the application; or

(b) approve the application sub ject to  other condition s or refuse the
application.

(3) The fee payable by the licensee for the application for the appointment of
a nominee shall be as prescribed in the Second Schedule.

(4) A nominee appointed under  paragraph (2) shall be subject to th ese
By-laws, conditions and restrictions imposed by the Perbadanan to the licensee and is
liable in the same manner as a licensee.

Employment of assistant
18. (1) A licensee shall not employ any person as an assistant without the prior
written approval of the Perbadanan.

(2) An application for an approval under paragraph (1) shall be made in such
form and manner as determined by the Perbadanan.

(3) The Perbadanan may—

(a) require the licensee to submit  further information for the purpose
of considering the application; or

(b) approve the application subject to  other conditions or refuse the
application.

(4) The employment of an assistant shall not exempt the licensee from
by-law 16(1).

(5) Any assistant employed under paragraph (4) is subject to—

(a) the provision s of these By-laws, conditions and restrictions
imposed by the Perbadanan under by-law 4(4); and

(b) any other conditions prescribed by the Perbadanan under
subparagraph 3(b).

(6) Notwithstanding this by-law, any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1)
commits an offence.

Licence shall be in respect of specific hawking site
19. (1) A licence issued under  by-law 4 shall be in respect of a designated
hawking site as specified in the licence.

(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Perbadanan, may in its discretion
upon an application made by a licensee , allow the transfer of a hawking site to anot her
hawking site to sell similar goods subject to—

(a) the payment of a fee as prescribed in the Second Schedule;

(b) the licens ee does not have any rental arrears f or the original
hawking site;

(c) the licensee has signed a tenancy agreement for the use of another
hawking site, if the Perbadanan thinks necessary; and

(d) other directions as may be determined by the Perbadanan.

(3) The Perbadanan may, if it deems necessary and appropriate, give notice in
writing to the licensee to transfer the hawking site allocated to him to another hawking
site within the period determined by the Perbadanan in the notice.

(4) Any licensee who fails to  comply with the notice under paragraph (3)
commits an offence.

(5) The licensee whose hawking site has been transferred under
paragraph (3) is not entitled to claim any compensation from the Perbadanan.

Size of stall, wall showcase and cart
20. (1) The maximum size for a stall is 5 metres long and 3 metres wide except
stalls built by the Perbadanan.

(2) No wall showcase shall exceed 4 metres long by 2 metres high by 1 metre
wide.

(3) The cart used by an itinerant hawker shall n ot exceed 2 metres long
and 1 metre wide and the cover or awning over it shall not extend more than 1 metre
beyond any part of the cart.

(4) Any licensee who contravenes this by-law commits an offence.

Construction of awning or cover over pitch
21. (1) No awning or any type of cover or structure shall be put up at any
hawking site, unless permitted by the Perbadanan, subject to any conditions as the
Perbadanan thinks necessary.

(2) The construction of an awning or cover or struct ure permitted under
paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the conditions imposed by the Perbadanan.

(3) The permission given under paragraph (1) may be withdrawn at any time
by the Perbadanan, upon being notified in writing of non -compliance of any of the
conditions imposed u nder paragraph (1) and the licensee shall demolish the awning,
cover or structure within the period specified by the Perbadanan in the notice.

(4) If the licensee fails to comply with the notice under  paragraph (3), the
Perbadanan may demolish the awning,  cover or structure and the Perbadanan may
recover the expenses incurred by the Perbadanan for the demolishing works from the
licensee.

(5) The Perbadanan shall not be liable to pay any compensation to the
licensee for actions taken under this by-law.

(6) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) or (2) commits an offence.

Demolition and seizure
22. (1) The Perbadanan may giv e notice in writing to any  licensee to demolish
any stall, wall showcase, awning, cover or structure over any stall or pitch
constructed—

(a) which does not comply with the size specified in by-law 20; or

(b) without the permission of the Perbadanan,

within the period specified by the Perbadanan in the notice.

(2) If the licensee fails to c omply with the notice under  paragraph (1), the
Perbadanan, after the expiry of the period specified in the notice , may take steps to
demolish the stall, wall showcase, awning, cover or structure on the pitch without
paying any compensation to the licensee and the Perbadanan may claim the
demolishing cost from the licensee.

(3) The Perbadanan may seize any vehicle used for a hawking activity
without the approval of the Perbadanan or a cart used by any licensee which is not in
accordance with the size for the cart to be used for hawking activity under by-law 20(3).

(4) Any licensee may claim the vehicle or cart s eized under  paragraph (3)
within the period determined by the Perbadanan subject to by-law 36(3).

(5) The Perbadanan shall not be liable for any damages and losses incurred
by the licensee as a result of the actions taken by the Perbadanan under this by-law.

Prohibitions on hawking activity
23. (1) No licensee shall operate his hawking activity—

(a) within 9 metres of a street junction; or

(b) within 3.6 metres of a fire hydrant.

(2) No licensee shall operate his hawking activity  in suc h manner as to
obstruct or to interfere with the free flow of vehicular traffic and the free movement of
pedestrians.

(3) No licensee or his assistant shall use a loudhailer, loudspeaker,
microphone or any other instrument for intensifying sound in the course of his hawking
activity.

(4) Any licensee who contravenes this by-law commits an offence.

Placing and moving of stall
24. (1) A licensee shall comply with such verbal or written directions given by
the Perbadanan from time to time with regard to the placing of his stall, goods  or other
equipment relating to his hawking activity at any hawking site.

(2) A temporary hawker shall remove his stall, vehicle, goods and other
equipment relating to his hawking activity when the period and time of hawking end.

(3) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) or (2) commits an offence.

Vehicles
25. (1) A licensee who uses a vehicle for the purpose of hawking activity  shall
ensure the vehicle is in accordance with the size or sha pe as determined by the
Perbadanan.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Itinerant hawker
26. (1) An itinerant hawker other than an itinerant hawker who uses a van shall
be continuously on the move except when engaged in the selling of goods to customers.

(2) An itinerant hawker using a van shall operate his hawking activity at the
pitch permitted by the Perbadanan within the period and time specified in the licence
and shall remove his van from the pitch when the period and time of hawking end.

(3) No itinerant hawker using a van shall place or display for sale any goods
used for or related to his hawking activity outside the van.

(4) Any itinerant hawker who contravenes this by-law commits an offence.

Persons prohibited from handling food
27. (1) Any person who is suffering from or carrying any communicable disease
shall not be engaged in food preparation for hawking activity.

(2) Any person who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Method of handling food
28. (1) Any licensee or his assistant involved in food preparation—

(a) shall ensure that the food offered for sale is clean and safe to eat
and drink;

(b) shall use tongs, scoops, plastic gloves or other suitable utensil for
food preparation;

(c) shall not use his fingers to touch any other parts of his body during
food preparation;

(d) shall not use his breath to open any bag or wrapper used for the
sale of food;

(e) shall not wipe his hands with his clothing or by any means other
than with a clean towel or cloth;

(f) shall not cough or sneeze near any food;

(g) shall not smoke;

(h) shall keep himself and his clothes in a clean condition and shall at
all times wear an apron, a head cover and such other things as
directed by the Perbadanan from time to time;

(i) does not have cuts or skin abrasions on his hands or fingers; and

(j) shall use a clean towel for the purpose of wiping or cleaning any
package or articles used for the food preparation.

(2) Any licensee or his assistant who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an
offence.

Places where food preparation is prohibited
29. (1) A licensee or his assistant shall not prepare food—

(a)  in any toilet or bathroom;

(b)  in any place where any thing or animal is allowed to be or kept; or

(c) in any place where the f ood is likely to be contaminated or
becomes polluted or cleanliness of the food will be affected.

(2) Any licensee or his assistant who contravenes  paragraph (1) commits an
offence.

Sanitary requirements
30. (1) A licensee and his assistant shall ensure that—

(a) any type of food for sale is sold and prepared on a surface with the
height of 0.5 meters above the ground or floor;

(b) the hawking site is maintained so as to be in a clean condition at all
times;

(c) the surrounding areas which is immediately in front of, behind and
beside the  hawking site assigned to the licensee are in a clean
condition;

(d) the food offered for sale  shall be in a clean condition and covered
with a food cover at all times;

 (e) the vehicles used for hawking or transporting  food for sale  are
always in a clean condition;

(f)  the equipment and fixtures used in the hawking activity shall be in
a clean condition;

(g) only containers or packing tools as determined or permitted by the
Perbadanan is used to wrap up food for sale;

(h) the food for customers is not  wrapped in unclean paper or paper
with writing or printed matter on it or with material which might
contaminate the food;

(i) all equipment used in his hawking activity  must be kept in a
proper place and in a clean condition;

(j) the licensee and his assistant  shall always wear clean clothes and
shall also wear an apron and a cap;

(k) litter bins  of any type and  size as determined  by the Perbadanan
are sufficiently provided;

(l) all garbage is collected and  packed in plasti c bag s and placed in
sealed containers provided for that purpose,  and shall ensure the
containers are emptied  and cleaned as often as necessary  for the
purpose of cleanliness at all times;

(m) paper or material that is not clean shall not be used for the packing
of goods;

(n) the packaging or containers used  for packing  fruit and vegetable
shall not be made  from materials that will contaminate or change
the colour or taste of the fruit  or vegetable, or cause the fruit or
vegetable to be in a condition that is injurious to health; and

(o) any poison  or any  harmful substance or any  other material that
may pollute the  good condition  of the goods for  sale shall not  be
used in his hawking site.

(2) Any licensee or his assistant who fails to comply with  paragraph (1)
commits an offence.

Prohibition on sale of unwholesome food
31. (1) A licensee shall not sell or offer for sale any unwholesome food for human
consumption.

(2) The Perbadanan may investigate, inspect and seize any  food which is
unwholesome for human consumption and  may direct the food to be destroyed
immediately.

(3) The licensee  is not entitled  to claim any  compensation from the
Perbadanan for any food seized by the Perbadanan under paragraph (2).

(4) Notwithstanding paragraphs (2) and (3), any licensee who contravenes
paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Hawking pitch not to be assigned, leased, let out or sublet
32. (1) A licensee shall not assign, lease, let out or sublet  the pitch allocated to
him to any person.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Change of goods licensed
33. (1) No licensee shall sell or display for sale any goods other than the goods
specified in the licence except with the written approval of the Perbadanan.

(2) An application for an  approval under paragraph (1) shall be in writing  in
such form and  manner determined by the Perbadanan and the Perbadanan may, at its
discretion, approve or not approve the application.

(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), any licensee who contravenes
paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Operating hours for hawking activity
34. (1) The Perbadanan may direct hawking activity  at any hawking site  to be
operated within the period  and time as specified by the Perbadanan and the licensee
shall comply with such directions.

(2) The Perbadanan may consider an application from the licensee to  extend
the period and time for hawking specified by the Perbadanan under paragraph (1) upon
receiving an application in writing from the licensee.

(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), any licensee who  contravenes
paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Water supply
35. (1) A licensee shall not use any water other than water from a  public water
supply and shall not use the pipe d water from any toilet  for the op eration of his
hawking activity.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Demolition, seizure and claims
36. (1) Notwithstanding by-law 22, the Perbadanan may at its discretion—

(a) seize, remove and detain any  goods, vehicle, equipment or stall
relating to  the hawking activity  of a person  who is not licensed
under these By-laws; or

(b) demolish any  stall, wall showcase, awning, cover or structure
belonging to any unlicensed hawker.

(2) The Perbadanan may dispose of goods of a perishable nature immediately
by any means deemed appropriate by the Perbadanan.

(3) Any person whose goods, vehicle, equipment or stall has been seized and
detained under paragraph (1) shall claim the goods, vehicle, equipment or stall within
the period given by the Perbadanan subject to the payment of any fee prescribed by the
Perbadanan in the Third Schedule and if no claim is  made within the period  provided,
such goods, vehicle, equipment or stall will be disposed of in  such manner  as may be
determined by the Perbadanan.

(4) The Perbadanan shall not be liable  for any goods , vehicle, equipment or
stall which has been seized and disposed of under this by-law.

(5) Any person  whose goods, vehicle, equipment or stall  has been seized,
detained or disposed o f under this by-law shall not be entitled to claim  any
compensation from the Perbadanan.

Nuisance
37. (1) A licensee shall not, during the operation of his hawking activity, create or
cause or allow any nuisance to occur.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Power to require information
38. (1) For the purpose of tracing the source and preventing the sp read of any
infection, the Perbadanan may require a licensee to furnish any information or produce
for inspection any document, book or record relating to his assistant.

(2) Any licensee who refuses to give any information or produce any
document, book or record commits an offence.

Exemption
39. The Perbadanan may, conditionally or unconditionally, exempt any licensee from
any provisions of these By-laws.

Penalty
40. Any person who contravenes any provisions of these By-laws commits an offence
and shall, upon conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding two thous and ringgit or to
imprisonment not exceeding one year or to both , and in the case of a continuing offence
to a fine not exceeding two hundred ringgit for each day during which the offence is
continued after conviction.

Revocation and transitional provisions
41. (1) The Labuan Municipal Council (Hawkers) By -Laws 1968
[G.N.L. 11 of 1968] is revoked.

(2) Any licence issued or approval granted under the revoked By -laws before
the coming into operation of these By -laws shall continue in full force until the licence
expires, is amended, suspended or cancelled, or the approval expires or revoked under

the revoked By-laws, for which purpose only the revoked By-laws shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

(3) Any proceedings pending or commenced under the revoked By -laws
before the coming into operation of these By -laws shall be continued and concluded
under the revoked By-laws as if these By-laws has not been made.
